scores.evidence: The whole lesson uses warm です・ます, and the card backs, the q9 scenario and the checklist labels all end politely. The four round-1 breaks are fixed: the p-claude hint now writes 「Ctrl + Oで開くトランスクリプト（transcript）画面で」, the plain-text fields no longer put a space before particles (「.envでは」「/hooksのPreToolUseに」「（--scopeで選ぶ）」), and every q9 option ends in a verb (d: 「…Bは作者とソースがわかるので入れる」). Each piece of wrong-option feedback is at most two sentences and names the misconception (s1-check, s3-check, s5-check, practice-b-quiz, check-quiz).

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1705 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 16.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, so estMinutes matches. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. s3-pitfall is now three sentences. The sections mix short text with tables, code, a diagram and checks, and the new practice-b-model-b table splits the A and B write-ups into two narrow tables.

The prerequisites list 第2回, 第6回 and 第7回, and the text recalls each one where it matters (s1-lead 「第6回のとおり」, q2 explanation 「第2回の権限ルール」, s5-lead 「第7回のスキルやサブエージェントは…プラグインとしてまとめて配れます」). No segment introduces more than three terms, and the definitions match the glossary word for word (s1-defs, s2-defs, s4-defs, s5-defs). MCP is spelled out in s4-lead, and 「リンター（linter）」 and 「トランスクリプト（transcript）」 have their English on first use.

The lesson declares one locale (jp), and every string, including the diagram labels, caption and alt, is in Japanese. The diagram labels match the alt (「PreToolUseフック」). The summary-next link text 「フックの公式ガイド（日本語）」 names its destination.

niceToHave: s4-scopes: in the project row, 「使う前に承認」 does not say who approves — 「このプロジェクト・チーム全員。対話セッションでは、使う前に承認」→「このプロジェクト・チーム全員。対話セッションでは、使う前に承認の確認が出る」
s3-table: the table writes 「ふだんの権限確認へ」 while the diagram, the diagram alt and the q3 feedback write 「権限の確認」. Use one form — 「進む。表示はなく、ふだんの権限確認へ（許可ではない）」→「進む。表示はなく、ふだんの権限の確認へ（許可ではない）」
practice-b-model-b: the 出どころ row describes the source code, not where B is distributed from (s5-checks defines it as 「どこから配られているか」) — 「ソースが公開されている」→「公開されたソースから配られている」
hook-predict: q0 option d repeats 「モード」 — 「権限モードをManualモードにして、毎回自分で確認する」→「権限モードをManualにして、毎回自分で確認する」

practice-steps: the p-predict hint changes only tool_input, while the JSON in the example test still says 「"tool_name":"Bash"」. The script never reads tool_name, so the test still works, but a learner may wonder about it — 「`tool_input` を `{"file_path":".env"}` に変えます。」→「`tool_name` を `Edit` に、`tool_input` を `{"file_path":".env"}` に変えます。」

practice-b-quiz: the q9 prompt is still a long inline paragraph of six sentences. Inline prompts cannot hold paragraph breaks, so the closing question could move up front — 「架空の候補です。」→「架空の2候補について、いちばん適切な判断を選びます。」 (then drop the final 「いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？」 and end with 「どれを選びますか？」)
summary: The scope check required a full review (exit 1: 22 of 49 blocks changed, 45%, more than 30%). I did a full review of the current version (sha256:4e07cfeed4cb390f). All four must-fix items from round 1 are fixed. s3-pitfall is three sentences, the hint writes 「Ctrl + O」, the plain-text fields no longer put a space before particles, and every q9 option ends in a verb. The round-1 suggestions were also applied: the ex-register troubleshoot, the ex-test wording, 「Prettier」 in s1-config, the s5-lead sentence on plugins, the 「あなた」 wording in s5-risk, the q8 option lengths and wording, and the preview of 第9回, which now matches the cc-09 title 「第9回｜並列で進める・自動で回す」. The changed text has no new errors in classes (a)–(e): lessons:lint --strict is clean, the terms match the glossary, and the measured length (prose 1705, est 16.9 min) matches estMinutes 17. The remaining items are small wording choices (niceToHave).
